seo.title: SSH tunnels, cloud sign-in and connection import
seo.description: Reach databases through SSH jump hosts, proxies or kubectl, sign in with AWS IAM or Entra ID, and bring connections over from TablePlus, DBeaver and more.

header.title: Connections
header.lead: Save and organize connections, reach private servers through SSH and tunnels, and sign in with your cloud account.

bands.title: Organize connections
text: Paste a URL, jdbc: and +ssh ones included, and the form fills itself. Arrange connections in nested groups with tags, colors and favorites, keep several in one window or give one its own, and each remembers its last tab.
notes: iPhone and iPad give a connection one tag.

bands.title: Bring your connections
text: <ui>Import from Other App</ui> reads {connectionImportApps}, with passwords where the source app allows it. <ui>Open Project Folder</ui> finds database settings in environment, framework and Docker files, and <ui>Import from AWS</ui> lists the RDS and Aurora databases a profile can see.

bands.title: SSH, TLS and tunnels
text: Connect over SSH with a password, a key, an agent or a prompt, through jump hosts, and keep tunnels as reusable profiles. TLS runs from Required to Verify Identity. SOCKS5, Cloudflare Access, the Cloud SQL Auth Proxy and your own command, such as kubectl port-forward, cover the rest.
notes: Linux and iPhone and iPad connect through SSH and TLS.

bands.title: Sign in with your cloud account
text: AWS IAM signs a fresh token at every connect, from a key, a profile or IAM Identity Center. SQL Server signs in with Microsoft Entra ID or Kerberos, and BigQuery, Spanner and the Cloud SQL Auth Proxy can use your Google account.
notes: Linux signs in with Kerberos. iPhone and iPad use Entra ID on connections synced from a Mac.

bands.title: Passwords and credentials
text: Passwords and SSH passphrases go to the macOS Keychain. Credential profiles reuse a login and read passwords from 1Password, Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, a command, a file or the environment, for free. Environment Variables, part of Pro, fills $DB_HOST and other fields when you connect.
notes: Linux keeps passwords in the system keyring.

more.title: Connection policies
text: Each connection sets its Safe Mode level, what MCP and AppleScript clients may do, whether the AI assistant can see it, and its own connect and query timeouts.

more.title: On iPhone and iPad
text: The app has its own connection form, SSH with a password or a key, TLS, and passwords in the Keychain.
